taxes.tax: Stamp duty (IAJD) on conveyances of property: no tariff for notarial deeds
taxes.statute: Ley n.º 1/2024 Tributaria (19 November 2024, in force on publication; OCR world/B08-central-africa-fr/gq/law/rescue3/Ley1-2024_ocr_spa.txt) art. 240-247 Impuesto sobre Actos Jurídicos Documentados
taxes.dated: Ley Núm. 1/2024 (Ley Tributaria), in force for 2025
taxes.why: art. 241 7) lists 'las escrituras, actas y testimonios notariales' as taxable operations and art. 243 1) e) gives the base of first copies of notarial deeds, but the tariff of art. 245 has only three items: preventive annotations in notarial and property / commercial registers 0,15 %, bills of exchange and similar titles 0,5 %, BVMAC listing authorisations 1 %. No rate applies to the deed of a home purchase, so a household's conveyance bears no IAJD; the transfer itself is taxed by the ITP (P5, art. 233). A preventive annotation (0,15 %) is not part of an ordinary purchase and is not modelled
